quote.text: Elon Musk, Trump and the GOP's largest funder for the last two election cycles, who played a cruical role in served in the Trump administration to implement MAGA policies, wants you to know he is a moderate, and not MAGA at all.

images.alt:
After spending extremely heavily to support Republicans over the last three years, Musk has pivoted hard to paint himself as a moderate in this interview.

First, he expressed optimism about the new Texas Democratic governor, Gina Hinojosa. He said she “is going to be quite moderate” and that things in the state will be “fine” with her as governor.

Next, he said that it would be good for Washington to have split control between the two parties.

Then, he said that he is “not MAGA” and thinks “there are positives and negatives in both parties.”

He added, “I’m not sure what MAGA means, but if that means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican Party, then I certainly don’t have that.”

It features a orangutan with boxer shorts on surfing on a briefcase with his hands behind his head, looking extremely chill, in front of (but, because of forced perspective, roughly the same size as) the gleaming high-rise Majestic Hotel. items.body_excerpt: A reminder that before the season Ayo Dosunmu says he feels more pressure after signing his 5-year, $112M contract as the Wolves invested in him and now it’s his mission to make that $112M look like a steal for Minnesota.

quote.author: Hoop Informatics
quote.text:
A lot of good answers especially on how to play alongside Rudy Gobert.

But the best one, when asked how freeing it is to have signed a 5-year contract Ayo said it’s just the opposite. He feels more pressure now. They invested in him so he’s locked in & focused. He wants to outplay his new contract.
